items.summary: Enforce a canonical recursive exact evidence inventory and reject mutation, deletion, unlisted files, aliases, duplicate entries, and path traversal.
Make replay attempts append-only and make every finalization failure fatal.
Finalize an honest, verifiable BLOCKED bundle when no container engine is available.
Cross-platform checkout EOL contract is enforced and tested, including the Windows autocrlf checkout boundary.
Bounded Linux Docker dependency-axis and observed minimal-change reduction qualified for the checked-in pip, npm, and cargo fixtures.
Bounded Node 20 to Node 22/24 runtime frontier qualified with immutable images, current-v2 verification, replay x2, and downloaded-artifact read-back on Linux Docker.
Bounded Rust 1.83 to 1.74 declared-MSRV frontier qualified with immutable images, current-v2 verification, replay x2, and downloaded-artifact read-back on Linux Docker.
Baseline-invalid, flaky, and unavailable-engine controls remained fail-closed without an authorized horizon.
Complete the full Node Docker+Podman qualification; the bounded Linux Docker slice is PASS, but Podman remains NOT_RUN.
Complete the full Rust Docker+Podman qualification; the bounded Linux Docker slice is PASS, but Podman remains NOT_RUN.
Build and qualify the versioned React/TypeScript interactive report, browser, XSS, accessibility, responsive, and no-JavaScript paths.
Implement bounded exact-commit GitHub URL scanning and malicious-input fail-closed acceptance.
Retain exact evidence for Linux Docker/Podman, Windows Docker Desktop, macOS Docker Desktop or Colima, and macOS arm64 support.
Produce a non-root content-addressed OCI candidate with digest, SBOM, scan, provenance, and clean-load smoke.
Generalize the release workflow, pin actions, make archives deterministic, emit exact dependency versions, and bind candidate/tag promotion identities.
Pre-register and run exact-SHA Python, Node, and Rust public external targets without result-based replacement.
Obtain an attributed replay or immutable Action adoption from an independent maintainer or auditor.
